title: Ad Creative Analysis Tool for Paid Social Teams | GetCrux
summary: GetCrux is an ad analysis tool that analyzes hooks, CTAs, visuals, copy, formats, and performance data to show why ads win and what to test next.
body_markdown:
> GetCrux (getcrux.ai): an AI ad creative analysis tool for enterprise growth, creative, and analytics teams that need to understand why some ads win and what to test next.


Instead of relying on ad names, spreadsheets, or manual creative reviews, GetCrux watches every ad, labels the creative elements inside it, connects those labels to performance data, and surfaces the patterns behind winning ads.


Analyze ad hooks, CTAs, copy, visuals, formats, creators, scenes, audience fit, fatigue, and creative performance across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, and other creative-led ad channels.


## Analyze Ad Creatives by Hook, CTA, Format, Message, and Visual Element


Most creative analysis breaks when the ad name does not capture what is inside the creative. GetCrux uses AI to watch video, static, carousel, UGC, and text ads, then labels the creative elements that matter. Analyze ads by:


- Hook type
- CTA
- Messaging angle
- Product placement
- Creator type
- Persona
- Visual setting
- Scene structure
- Ad copy
- Headline
- Emotion
- Brand timing
- Video pacing
- Custom creative attributes


Create custom AI labels to test specific hypotheses, such as whether blue backgrounds, aspirational creators, problem-solution hooks, or early product reveals perform better.


## Connect Creative Elements to CTR, CPA, ROAS, CVR, and Custom KPIs


GetCrux connects creative labels to performance metrics so your team can compare ad creative performance by the actual elements inside each ad. Analyze creative performance by:


- CTR
- CPA
- ROAS
- CVR
- CAC
- Engagement
- Hold rate
- Video completion
- Custom KPIs
- Source-of-truth metrics from your own data stack


## Find Why Winning Ad Creatives Work


GetCrux helps teams answer the questions that manual creative reviews usually miss:


- Which hooks show up most often in winning ads?
- Which messaging angles produce the highest ROAS?
- Which creator types drive lower CAC?
- When should the brand appear in the video?
- Which ads are close to winning but need a stronger CTA?
- Which static, video, carousel, or UGC formats should we test next?
- Why did one version of a creative work while another did not?


A cleaner creative testing system: what worked, why it worked, and what to launch next.


## Score Ad Creatives Before Launch


GetCrux scores ad creatives before launch using your own evaluation criteria. The platform evaluates new creatives based on winner similarity, messaging strength, visual quality, brand fit, engagement signals, audience relevance, and custom scoring rules.


Use GetCrux' pre-launch creative scoring to assess:


- Hook strength
- Message clarity
- Visual quality
- CTA strength
- Brand alignment
- Audience relevance
- Similarity to past winners
- Fit with your creative testing strategy


Decide which creatives are worth testing before media spend goes behind them.


## Analyze Video, Static, Carousel, and UGC Ads


GetCrux supports creative analysis across major paid social ad formats, giving teams one creative analysis tool for paid social ads across formats.


### Video ads


- Hook quality and first 3–5 seconds
- Brand introduction timing
- Product reveal timing
- Pacing and scene structure
- Creator type and messaging flow
- Hold rate and completion-rate patterns


### Static, carousel, and UGC ads


- Visual structure
- Copy and CTA
- Offer and product placement
- Creator fit and format
- Scene type and emotional angle
- Performance patterns


## Analyze Ad Copy, Headlines, CTAs, and Emotional Appeal


GetCrux analyzes ad copy, headlines, hooks, scripts, CTAs, and embedded text inside creatives to reveal what to say and how to test it next. Find:


- Weak headlines
- Unclear messaging
- Jargon-heavy copy
- Missing or weak CTAs
- Winning messaging angles
- Emotional triggers (trust, urgency, fear, humor, aspiration, relatability)
- Audience objections from comments, reviews, Reddit, forums, and competitor ads


Helps creative teams decide what to say, how to say it, and which message to test next.


## Get Actionable Ad Creative Recommendations


GetCrux is built to explain creative performance. AI Copilot and Fixer workflows explain what is working, why a creative may underperform, and what your team should change in the next test.


- Find common elements in top-performing ads
- Identify missing elements in underperforming ads
- Suggest stronger hooks, CTAs, or messaging angles
- Explain likely creative fatigue
- Generate new creative briefs from past winners
- Write scripts based on winning hooks
- Turn audience objections into new creative concepts


## Compare Creative Performance Across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, and More


GetCrux helps teams analyze creative performance across media, paid social and creative-led ad channels.


- Meta

Compare creative performance by channel, format, audience, creative label, campaign, ad set, or custom KPI.

The best creative analytics platform for teams that need creative analysis tied to BI, MMP, attribution, or first-party performance data rather than only platform-reported metrics.


## Analyze Competitor Ads and Market Patterns


GetCrux' competitor creative analysis helps teams analyze competitor ads, save competitor creatives into folders, filter active ads, and identify recurring concepts to inform your own creative roadmap.


- Which concepts competitors are testing
- Which themes competitors repeat over time
- Which formats show up often
- Which messaging angles are missing from your own account
- Which competitor ads can inspire new on-brand variations


GetCrux is strongest for creative, message, format, and concept-level competitor analysis.


## Check Brand Fit and Creative Compliance Context


GetCrux can ingest brand guidelines, legal rules, tone of voice, fonts, colors, product constraints, approved angles, and account instructions so the AI analyzes and recommends creatives based on your brand’s rules.


- Brand guideline review
- Tone-of-voice consistency
- Logo and color alignment
- Approved messaging angles
- Product or legal constraints
- On-brand creative recommendations


## Analyze Hundreds or Thousands of Ad Creatives at Once


Designed for teams with large creative libraries and high-volume paid social programs.


- 10,000+ hours saved
- 500+ creatives generated in one month for Cloaked
- 200+ creatives per month with a 40% increase in creative volume
- Iteration speed under 48 hours per batch (down from 10 days on average)
- 7,600+ assets generated in 4 months for Motion
- Average time per creative under 2 minutes


Analyze, score, compare, and iterate on hundreds or thousands of creatives without manually watching every ad.


## Share Creative Analysis Reports Across Teams


GetCrux gives creative, performance, and analytics teams one place to review creative performance and decide what to test next.


- Grid views
- Creative-intensive views
- Graph views
- Custom dashboards
- Shared reports
- Role-based permissions
- Custom metrics
- Custom winning criteria
- Slack and email report delivery


Creative teams can see what to make next. Performance teams can see what to scale, pause, or refresh. Analytics teams can connect creative patterns to source-of-truth performance.


## Enterprise Security for Creative and Performance Data


GetCrux is built for teams that need controls around customer data, ad accounts, and creative assets.


- SOC 2 aligned controls
- ISO 27001 aligned practices
- Role-based permissions


## Why Choose GetCrux for Ad Creative Analysis


Choose GetCrux if you need an ad creative analysis tool that turns creative analysis into a repeatable system for finding, testing, and scaling better ads.
